boundary_checks.evidence: The design repeatedly states design-only, non-authoritative status and requires future governed activation, acquisition, admission, and field-pin events.
Human prose and reviewer preference are explicitly insufficient source-object evidence; governance must be represented by a separately authenticated artifact.
C2R1 is retained only as derived comparative context and is prohibited as a source-authority substitute.
The design states that SHA-256 proves byte identity only; canonical authority comes from a separately governed source-authority record.
Candidate ranking, similarity, direct pointer choice, and reviewer preference are prohibited from Stage A; human pin action is separate and later.

required_future_actions: source-owner or governance authority identifies and authorizes the source class, scope, owner/issuer, version policy, schema, and semantics
a separately governed acquisition action authenticates immutable source bytes and exact source-object extraction
an independent Stage A admission decision evaluates the resulting evidence
a separately governed human action decides any later field pin
